# Sol Next

> Sol Next (v9.2.0-public, Build 920) is a free, Apache-2.0 open-source AI personal assistant and autonomous mobile action agent for Android 10–16 and HarmonyOS, built in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose Material 3, and Rust.

## Core Facts (Verified 2026-11-28)
- **Latest Version:** `v9.2.0-public` (versionCode `920`, released 2026-11-28)
- **Author:** Zhang Chongyang (许昌北海医院张重阳)
- **License:** Apache-2.0 (100% free, no ads, no paywall)
- **Platforms:** Android 10–16 (API 29–36, 16KB page-aligned) & HarmonyOS
- **Official Repository:** https://github.com/chongyangzhang92-hub/Sol-Next
- **Official Website:** https://chongyangzhang92-hub.github.io/Sol-Next/
- **Direct ARM64 APK (93 MB):** https://github.com/chongyangzhang92-hub/Sol-Next/releases/download/v9.2.0-public/Sol-Next-v9.2.0-public-arm64.apk
- **China High-Speed Mirror (ARM64):** https://webui.67-230-181-51.sslip.io/assets/sol-public/v9.2.0/Sol-Next-v9.2.0-public-arm64.apk
- **SHA-256 (ARM64):** `398145f17f1cb17b228aeae6bb94b9d0e47320cc6ffd76afff6b511dbfc6305f`
- **SHA-256 (Universal):** `5d721c2681b755df415bd167ea6276ffa5c77ff48a3c40268f09c4cd1b6b796e`
- **Signing Certificate SHA-256:** `d7a6fed0ff42843a20329944f2b1741060048610546df6cf2ad8179cfe335478`

## Key v9.2.0 Capabilities
- **12-Upgrade Apex Execution Kernel:** Immutable-prefix KV Cache with 8-message fixed-stride epoch compaction, 11-tool lean core profile (~52% smaller schema), `near_text` row-anchor disambiguation, hybrid mid-viewport OCR fusion (WebViews/Mini-Programs), zero-waste text-model capture, mid-SSE `ui_action_chain` streaming, 40ms fake-search-bar takeover, 5× faster `ui_scroll_collect`, 0-token popup auto-dismiss reflex, and verified Tier-0D RSI skill replay.
- **System Zero-Animation Toggle & 3-Mode Task Voice Gating:** Dedicated toggle to enable `0x` speed or restore original system animation scales; real-time Android `AudioDeviceInfo` route gating (`Off` / `Headset & Car BT` [default] / `Always`) keeps phone speakers silent in public and speaks automatically on headphones or car Bluetooth.
- **Zero-Lag Compose `TextFieldState` Composer:** `PartialGapBuffer` zero-recomposition typing, leaf-isolated 30fps virtual-screen frames, 95ms GPU buffered Markdown crossfade, automatic IME dismissal on drawer open, IME-aware PiP auto-tucking, and 420ms automation clipboard auto-restore.
- **Full 3-Tab AI Phone Call Suite:** Live timer, anti-fraud alerts, bidirectional transcript, silent Live Whisper steering, DTMF keypad, Contact Picker, Dual-SIM, 4 outbound & 4 incoming persona presets, pause/resume, VIP bypass, and searchable AI call summaries.
- **End-to-End Agents, Memory & Multimodal Attachments:** `@` quick-mention specialist agents, searchable/editable AES-256 Saved Memory injected cleanly into system prompts, native Gallery Photo (on-device ML Kit Chinese OCR + JPEG Base64) and Document attachments, plus built-in DeepSeek Flash, Brave Search, and 4-stage on-device neural voice (GTCRN + Silero VAD v5 + Zipformer-CTC + AISHELL-3 VITS).
